serverInfo.name: chiwawa-registry
serverInfo.title: Chiwawa — AI Agent Registry
serverInfo.description: Search and discover AI agents across A2A and MCP protocols. 7,000+ agents with health tracking.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search for AI agents in the Chiwawa registry by name, type, or status.

q.description: Full-text search on name and description

agent_type.description: Filter by type: a2a, mcp_live, or mcp_package

status.description: Filter by status: active, degraded, unresponsive, unreachable, gone, or archived

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate statistics for the Chiwawa registry: total agents, breakdown by type and health status.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get full details for a specific agent by UUID: provider, version, skills, auth schemes, and last 5 crawl results.

tools.name: submit_domain
tools.description: Submit a domain to the Chiwawa crawler queue to be probed for an A2A agent card.
